title: 第186章 家（加更！）
slug: 班级求生我是大客车内唯一男生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

顾屿驾驶着小货车猛地冲过终点，可车速没有丝毫减缓，反而继续向远处的木箱子冲去。

系统的提示音在顾屿和李沐晴脑海里响起：

【团队00520，驾驶的1级载具-武陵小货车，已通关副本，排名第三！】

【已通过副本，[C级宝箱]已发放至空间背包。】

什么C级宝箱的，顾屿现在压根不稀罕！

他只想沐晴好好的。

紧接着，系统的提示音再次响起：

【团队56547，驾驶的1级载具-武陵小货车，已通关副本，排名第三！】

他一脚刹车踩死，小货车在木箱前三四米处猛地刹停，轮胎磨着地面发出刺耳的尖锐响声，就像是用钥匙尖去刮玻璃，还飘起一股焦糊味。

车还没停稳，他就扯开安全带，猛地推开车门往下跳，脚落地时踉跄了一步，直接摔倒在地。

顾屿直接手脚并用地爬起来，快速往木箱冲。

李沐晴此时浑身无力，只能用模糊的眼睛，看着屿哥着急地跑向木箱子，她就像变成了一个近视眼。

顾屿一靠近木箱子，就看到木箱顶部躺着的那管翠绿色血清。

顾屿一把将血清握在手里，转身就往李沐晴的车门跑去。

他心里疯狂呐喊：

拿到了。

终于拿到了。

沐晴有救了！

可下一刻！顾屿看到黑色小轿车直接刹停在小货车后面，并伴随着刺耳的刹车声。

小轿车的三个车门同时被撞开。

刀哥、老二和老三直奔顾屿而来。

顾屿管不了那么多了，先给沐晴注射了血清再说。

他直接跑到李沐晴的车门。

刚将左手搭在车把上，顾屿就感觉天旋地转，随后脑袋一疼。

他这才发现，自己被人扑到了。

压在他身上的正是刀哥。

老二老三直接左右包抄，将想反抗的顾屿死死按住。

顾屿感受到自己被按住后，双手将血清紧紧握着，并护在怀里，他怒吼起来：

“都他妈滚开！！”

刀哥三人并没打算对顾屿动手，只是想将血清抢过来。

刀哥见老二和老三将顾屿摁好后，伸手握住顾屿的手指，并想把他手指掰开：

“兄弟，对不住了。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Gu Yu drove the small truck across the finish line, but the speed of the truck did not slow down at all. Instead, it continued to rush towards the wooden box in the distance.

The system's prompt sounded in the minds of Gu Yu and Li Muqing:

[Team 00520, driving the level 1 vehicle - Wuling pickup truck, has cleared the dungeon and ranks third!】

[The copy has been passed, [C-level treasure chest] has been issued to the space backpack.】

Gu Yu doesn't care about C-level treasure chests at all now!

He just wanted Mu Qing to be well.

Immediately afterwards, the system prompt sounded again:

[Team 56547 drives a level 1 vehicle - Wuling pickup truck, has cleared the dungeon, and ranks third!】

He slammed on the brakes, and the pickup truck suddenly stopped three or four meters in front of the wooden box. The tires scraped against the ground and made a sharp sound, like scraping the glass with the tip of a key. There was also a burning smell.

Before the car stopped, he pulled off his seat belt, pushed open the door and jumped down. When his feet landed, he staggered and fell directly to the ground.

Gu Yu climbed up on his hands and knees and rushed towards the wooden box quickly.

Li Muqing was so weak at this time that she could only watch Brother Yu running towards the wooden box anxiously with blurred eyes. She seemed to be short-sighted.

As soon as Gu Yu got close to the wooden box, he saw the tube of emerald green serum lying on the top of the wooden box.

Gu Yu held the serum in his hand, turned around and ran towards Li Muqing's car door.

他心里疯狂呐喊：

拿到了。

终于拿到了。

沐晴有救了！

可下一刻！Gu Yu saw the black car brake directly behind the minivan, accompanied by a harsh braking sound.

Three doors of the car were knocked open at the same time.

Brother Dao, Lao Er and Lao San came straight to Gu Yu.

Gu Yu couldn't care so much anymore, so he injected the serum into Mu Qing first.

He ran directly to Li Muqing's car door.

As soon as he put his left hand on the handlebar, Gu Yu felt like the world was spinning, and then his head hurt.

Only then did he realize that he had been jumped.

It was Brother Dao who was pressing on him.

The second and third oldest men surrounded him from left to right and held down Gu Yu who wanted to resist.

After Gu Yu felt that he was being held down, he held the serum tightly with both hands and protected it in his arms. He roared angrily:

"Get the fuck out of here!!"

Brother Dao and the others had no intention of attacking Gu Yu, they just wanted to grab the serum.

Brother Dao saw that after the second and third sons had pinned Gu Yu down, he stretched out his hand to hold Gu Yu's fingers and tried to pry them open:

"Brother, I'm sorry."
